messages:
sam: Heads-up — seeing a surge of late telemetry from EU region that's blowing up the recompute queue (depth x3). We need a short-run rate-cap + prioritization for the next 48h. /cc @tess @jyoti

Tess: Ack. Looking at logs — most are late-arriving events, some duplicates. Are we ok temporarily deprioritizing non-critical aggregates to keep SLOs? :thinking: 

sam: Proposed quick plan: 1) throttle recompute per-tenant to a conservative rate, 2) deprioritize low-priority aggregates (product-usage, ad-hoc counters) for 6h, 3) enable console banner + status page, 4) enable priority rescue flag for critical tenants.

jyoti: SLA impact: dropping low-priority will make some dashboards stale (up to a few hours) but 99% of read queries still return recent critical metrics. We should add a console annotation explaining staleness.

leo: +1 for prioritization lane: SLO-critical -> Paid/high-usage -> System metrics -> Low-priority. Also we should ensure we have a cache fallback for noncritical reads to avoid spikes.

morgan: I can flip a feature flag for a 'priority rescue' lane that will temporarily take a small fraction of capacity and route high-delta tenants earlier. Will roll it behind a console toggle.

sam: Action items: morgan toggles flag; tess prepares banner copy; jyoti patches rate-limiter; leo drafts status blurb and notifies on-call. Quick config guidance for recompute job: set batch_size=256, concurrency=8 and per-tenant token-bucket limiter to 10 tok/s (burst 50).

Tess: Banner draft: "We're addressing late telemetry affecting EU dashboards. Some non-critical aggregates may be stale for up to 6 hours while we prioritize critical metrics. More details at /status." Thoughts?

jyoti: I'll patch the recompute controller to add tenant_weight and a cutoff window (30d) and wire a token-bucket limiter. Pushing PR now (PR #1234). Example config snippet: 

```
recompute:
  batch_size: 256
  concurrency: 8
  per_tenant_limiter:
    rate: 10 # tokens/s
    burst: 50
```

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 (late-telemetry-eu). Pager: @leo

leo: I'm oncall and reviewing. Quick question: do reads have a safe fallback to cached aggregates if recompute is delayed? If yes, switch noncritical reads to cached path.

sam: Yes, cached_agg_v1 exists; we should extend TTL to avoid oscillation. I'll open a tiny console PR to mark noncritical dashboards as using cached reads while throttled.

morgan: Flag toggled in prod. Observability: recompute queue length down ~18% in 10m.

Tess: Banner live in console and tooltip explains prioritization lane. Added link to /status/INC-2026-042.

jyoti: PR merged and rate-limiter defaults set (10 tok/s, burst 50). Will watch for hot tenants and adjust weights.

leo: Drafted status update and sent to ops-sig for review. Will publish when improvement sustains (target: 10% reduction sustained for 30m).

sam: Re-evaluate in 2h. If we don't see improvement, escalate to capacity team to spin temporary extra pods for recompute.

morgan: Noted. Recording action: recompute:short-term-throttle in ops tracker.

Tess: Any objections to the plan? react here or speak up.

jyoti: :+1:

leo: :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks everyone — keep updates here and call if anything spikes.
